notes: Authoritative source: official RME M-32 DA Pro II-D User's Guide (docs.rme-audio.com), Hardware chapter (sections 3.10-3.18). 32 analog outputs are on 4x DB25 (D-Sub25) connectors, Tascam pinout, 8 channels each, labeled "LINE OUT Ch. 1-8", "Ch. 9-16", "Ch. 17-24", "Ch. 25-32" — modeled here as one representative DB25 port per octal group. Optical MADI (SFP, LC, 125 MBit/s) is optional/user-installable, not populated by default; modeled as fiber-lc connector since MADI optical uses LC fiber connectors, not SFP-electrical. MADI signal itself (56/64 ch coax or optical) is not in the provided grade enum (not SDI video), so no grade was set on the MADI BNC/fiber ports — omitting per instructions since MADI has no matching graded scale. Dante RJ45 ports (NET PRI/SEC) support 1 Gb/s and 100 Mb/s auto-negotiated; grade set to eth-1g reflecting max supported speed. USB 2.0 Type B port is control/remote-only (web remote over virtual network adapter) and does NOT carry audio; grade set usb-2.0 per its stated USB spec version. MIDI I/O is exposed via an included breakout cable terminating in a single 6-pin mini-DIN "TO DEVICE" jack on the rear panel (carries both MIDI IN and OUT); modeled as one bidirectional midi-din port. Word Clock I/O uses two separate 75-ohm BNC connectors (IN and OUT). Power: two independent IEC C14 inlets labeled "PSU 1" and "PSU 2" (100-240V AC, 50/60Hz, 45W each, dual redundant), both required for full redundancy but unit runs on either alone. Desktop/rack unit dimensions 440 x 44 x 243 mm, 1U rack-mountable (brackets included).
